resources.string: Save profiles, groups, routes, subscriptions and settings to one file
Restore a backup file. Current data is replaced
Loading a backup replaces your profiles, groups, routes, subscriptions and settings. Create a backup of the current data first if you need it.

Before you uninstall MatenLi or install a new version over it, create a backup in Settings. Uninstalling deletes all profiles, groups, subscriptions, routes and settings. After installing, open Settings and tap Load backup.
